Interview Experience — Google, ML Engineer
Date: March 5, 2026

I had a technical coding round with Google for the ML Engineer position.

The interviewer asked me to implement an LRU Cache from scratch.
I managed to come up with a solution using a doubly linked list and a hashmap,
but I struggled to explain why the time complexity was O(1) for both get and put.

The interviewer also asked me to optimise memory usage, but I could not come up
with a better approach under time pressure.

Feedback from interviewer:
- Good problem understanding and overall approach
- Weak on algorithm optimisation and time complexity explanation
- Communication could be clearer when walking through the solution

Result: Did not pass (Fail)

Next steps: practice more algorithm problems, focus on complexity analysis,
and do more mock interviews with time pressure.
